name: KromiumNavigationState
summary: Represents the current navigation and loading state of the browser.
declaration:
data class KromiumNavigationState(
    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
    val canGoBack: Boolean = false,
    val canGoForward: Boolean = false,
    val url: String = "",
    val title: String = ""
)

constructors.signature: KromiumNavigationState(isLoading: Boolean = false, canGoBack: Boolean = false, canGoForward: Boolean = false, url: String = "", title: String = "")

parameters.name: isLoading
parameters.description: Whether the browser is currently loading a resource.

parameters.name: canGoBack
parameters.description: Whether backward navigation is available in session history.

parameters.name: canGoForward
parameters.description: Whether forward navigation is available in session history.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: The title of the currently loaded page.
